name: na.StructTS
title: Replace NA by a structural time-series Kalman smoother

origin.description: Replace NA by a structural time-series Kalman smoother.
origin.usage:
na.StructTS(object, ...)
na.StructTS.ts(object, ..., na.rm = FALSE, maxgap = Inf)

arguments.name: object
arguments.text: A regular series with a frequency. A Zoo needs frequency greater than 1 so the basic structural model has a seasonal state.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If TRUE, trim ends that are still missing. The default keeps them.

arguments.name: maxgap
arguments.text: Runs longer than maxgap are put back to missing after the smoother.
Passed through to StructTS (type, init, fixed, optim.control).

origin.details: Missing values are replaced by the sum of the smoothed level and seasonal states from StructTS, dropping the slope. The variances are fit by L-BFGS-B on the concentrated Kalman likelihood. Frequency 1 selects the trend model, drops the only remaining column, and rowSums then fails.
origin.value: Observed points stay as they are. The three missing points of c(1, NA, 3, NA, NA) at frequency 4 are the smoothed level plus seasonal state.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(zoo))
stopifnot(packageVersion("zoo") == "1.9-1")
x <- as.numeric(na.StructTS(zooreg(c(1, NA, 3, NA, NA), frequency = 4)))
cat(paste(vapply(as.numeric(x), function(v) if (is.nan(v)) "NaN" else if (is.na(v)) "NA" else sprintf("%.12g", v), ""), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
